title: Building a Nested LADDER for LLM Unstructured Post-Training Pruning
abstract: arXiv:2610.28773v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Non-uniform allocation can improve post-training pruning of large language models, yet quality can still degrade sharply at high sparsity. To control degradation as sparsity increases, we introduce LADDER (Layer-Wise Allocation via Damage-Driven Evaluation and Refinement), which allocates sparsity incrementally. At each step, it evaluates pruning an additional fraction of weights from each eligible layer and commits the layer update that causes the least end-to-end degradation per removed parameter. This process produces non-uniform sparsity profiles and exactly nested masks across multiple budgets. We evaluate LADDER on five OPT, Llama, and Qwen models across 10-90% sparsity, using SparseGPT as its candidate-generation backend and comparing against uniform and adaptive allocation baselines. Results reveal a clear operating-regime trade-off: LADDER is comparable or slightly weaker at benign sparsity but becomes substantially more robust

translated_title: 为大语言模型非结构化训练后剪枝构建嵌套LADDER
translated_abstract: 非均匀分配可以改善大语言模型的训练后剪枝效果，但在高稀疏度下模型质量仍可能急剧下降。为了控制随稀疏度增加而导致的性能退化，我们提出了LADDER（通过损伤驱动评估与细化的逐层分配方法，Layer-Wise Allocation via Damage-Driven Evaluation and Refinement），该方法以增量方式分配稀疏度。在每一步中，它评估从每个符合条件的层额外剪除一部分权重，并提交使每个被移除参数造成端到端性能退化最小的层更新。这一过程产生了非均匀的稀疏度分布，并在多个预算下产生精确嵌套的剪枝掩码。我们在五个OPT、Llama和Qwen模型上，在10-90%的稀疏度范围内评估LADDER，使用SparseGPT作为候选生成后端，并与均匀分配和自适应分配基线进行比较。结果揭示了一个明显的工作区间权衡：LADDER在良性稀疏度下表现相当或略弱，但在高稀疏度下变得显著更加稳健。
tldr: LADDER通过逐层增量式评估稀疏度分配，在每步优先剪除单位参数移除造成端到端退化最小的层，从而生成非均匀稀疏分布和多预算下精确嵌套的剪枝掩码，显著提升大语言模型训练后剪枝在高稀疏度下的鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: LADDER incrementally allocates sparsity layer by layer—committing to the pruning update with the least end-to-end degradation per removed parameter—producing non-uniform sparsity profiles with exactly nested masks and substantially improving LLM post-training pruning robustness at high sparsity.
